summary: YHN Acquisition I Ltd filed an 8-K to report a $150,000 deposit into its trust account, extending the deadline to complete a business combination from June 19, 2026 to September 19, 2026. This is a routine extension deposit by a SPAC, not constituting a special situation event such as a definitive merger agreement or termination. The filing includes no deal terms, recommendation, or advisors, and merely provides additional time for the SPAC to identify a target. The deposit is standard to avoid liquidation; the expected close remains uncertain pending a future business combination. The risk-arb angle centers on whether a deal is announced before September 19.
